_approach: Minimal dubby breakdown at the deepest swing in the library: one quiet kick opens bar 1, rim ghosts whisper the 2-step placements, clave ticks stand in for crackle, an unchoked open hat rings once per bar and the snare appears only on beat 4 of bar 2. Space is the instrument. Ref: late-era stripped 2-step, the palette Burial inherited (Burial 'Distant Lights' intro). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
